tasks.title: 实现主悬浮窗指标、Pinned/ListView 与 Toast 呈现

convergence.visual: #990A0A0A-equivalent rgba background, 8px radius, software-rendered drop shadow
convergence.thresholds: <50 green #4ade80; <80 yellow #facc15; >=80 red #f87171; max<=0 memory green
convergence.models: PinnedStack uses a model; process details use virtualized Slint ListView; collapsed projection contains only pinned rows

tasks.title: 实现主窗拖拽、长按/点击、功耗与 Kill 状态机

convergence.pointer_precedence: strict >5 physical-pixel drag cancels click and long press; lost MouseUp cancel ends drag
convergence.coordinate_bridge: TouchArea logical coordinates + per-window DPI + current physical RECT produce physical pointer coordinates
convergence.production_move: continuous drag and release snap both call NativeWindowPositionOps::move_topmost, whose production implementation is SetWindowPos
convergence.snap: snap_floating_window uses 24px boundary and monitor rcWork with occupied taskbar edge exclusion; real Left-edge smoke ended at x=0 with set_window_pos=true
convergence.long_press: injected monotonic clock, 2000ms trigger, 0.90 visual scale, 200ms cancel/recovery; real 2150ms hold logged the trigger
convergence.click: 0.92 at 50ms and 1.0 at 150ms; panel lock transition remains deterministic
convergence.power: existing RestClient sequence GET /api/v1/power/warmup then POST /api/v1/power/scheme/next; success and error return through Toast without worker-thread Slint writes
convergence.kill: Idle to Confirming(1000ms/43.98) to Killing; second click dispatches one KillOnce call; safe process smoke returned Success and removed the row
convergence.hotkeys: zero RegisterHotKey, WM_HOTKEY, or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X matches
